author: Ariadne I
title: Osc2-CTX-FLoad (k=320, p=32) + V-OrthoReg λ=2e-5
abstract: Best-capacity regime (k=320, p=32) with slightly stronger V orthogonality (λ=2e-5) to test redundancy reduction vs. bias. Oscillatory 2nd-order SSM factors, input-adaptive temporal gating, global horizon gating, residual copy, and MAE+curvature.
